meta.title: Fees: fair prices, clear terms
meta.description: Our packages and what they include. Fees depend on destination, university and number of subjects; we put together the right package in a free consultation.

header.title: Fair prices, clear terms.
header.lede: The cost of preparation, university applications and visa support depends on the destination, university, number of subjects and timeline. So instead of one price for everyone, we offer a package that fits you.

blocks.title: Packages
blocks.caption: Packages and the services they include
rows: Core subjects (maths, English, sciences), live lessons, digital materials, weekly report for parents
3 (or 4) A-Level subjects, past paper coaching, mock exams, exam registration coordination, mentoring by a professor
Country and university shortlist (Safe / Target / Reach), personal statement editing, reference coordination, applications, scholarship research, visa file, interview practice
SAT, IELTS/TOEFL, UCAT/IMAT, portfolio: can be added to a package

items.title: Pay only for what you need
items.body: We build the package around your goal, with no unnecessary services.

items.title: Save a year
items.body: With A-Levels you may not need a foundation year. That is a year of tuition and living costs abroad.

items.title: Prepare from home
items.body: Online lessons mean no costs for a preparatory school abroad.

blocks.title: Costs paid separately
blocks.intro: Your offer states which of these are included in your package.

blocks.text: Instalment options and payment channels have not been decided yet.

paragraphs: We never charge anything that is not in the contract. Refund terms are set out in the contract and on the Refund policy page.
